intro: {{nameA}} in {{cityA}} and {{nameB}} in {{cityB}} both appear on this {{course}} comparison. The short title uses abbreviated labels; the names in the table are the ones to use when you read fees and campus notes.
JIIT Noida vs Noida International University for a doctorate is a fees-and-fit decision, not a placement ranking. We have no 2020 or later Ph.D placement row for either side.

sections.heading: JIIT Noida vs Noida International University for Ph.D: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose JIIT Noida if you want a doctorate at a long-running technical university in Noida and can budget for the higher recorded fee set on this page.
Choose Noida International University if you want a private-university Ph.D in Greater Noida at the lower recorded year total of ₹1 lakh, after you confirm supervision and the current fee notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For JIIT Noida the page may add several Doctor of Philosophy fee heads, including Total Fees year rows of ₹66,000 and ₹69,300, plus a ₹20,000 security and a ₹1,000 application fee, which can display as about ₹2.84 lakh.
The ₹1,000 application fee is not tuition. Do not treat it as the cheapest Ph.D option. The recorded year totals and security deposit are the figures to check against the official notice.

For Noida International University we hold ₹1 lakh as a Total Fees year figure. That is a year amount, not a confirmed multi-year doctoral total. Confirm both official fee PDFs before you compare cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Doctoral outcomes are usually about thesis work, fellowships and academic or research jobs, not a campus average package. Our table has no 2020 or later Ph.D placement row for either college.
If a stipend, teaching assistantship or industry project matters to you, ask the doctoral office directly. Do not borrow undergraduate or MBA packages and treat them as Ph.D results.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam mapped on this page. Most doctoral admissions still use a university test, an interview, and a postgraduate marks rule, so follow the official Ph.D notification.
A supervisor and research area matter more than the fee gap. Write to the department with a short proposal and check whether a seat is actually open in your subject this year.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: JIIT is in Noida and Noida International University is in Greater Noida. If you will live at home or travel daily, that difference is practical, not cosmetic.
Both are private universities in Uttar Pradesh's NCR belt. Visit the lab or department, not only the main gate, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick JIIT Noida if the technical-university setting and your intended supervisor are the priority, and you have confirmed the official multi-year fee rather than relying only on our added year heads.
Pick Noida International University if the recorded ₹1 lakh year fee fits your budget and the department can show you a supervisor in your area.
Because Ph.D placements are missing on this page, do not use the comparison table's empty package cells as a reason to hurry the decision.

faqs.question: What Ph.D fee is on record for JIIT Noida?
faqs.answer: Our table includes Total Fees year rows of ₹66,000 and ₹69,300, a ₹20,000 security, and a ₹1,000 application fee, which may display as about ₹2.84 lakh. The application fee is not tuition. Confirm the official multi-year total.

faqs.question: What Ph.D fee is on record for Noida International University?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹1 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for the Doctor of Philosophy programme. That is not a confirmed multi-year total. Check the official fee notice on niu.edu.in.

faqs.question: Is the ₹1,000 JIIT row the full doctoral fee?
faqs.answer: No. That is an application fee. Use the recorded year totals and the official JIIT Ph.D fee notice, not the application amount, when you compare cost.

faqs.question: Are Ph.D placements listed for these two universities?
faqs.answer: No. We have no 2020 or later doctoral placement row for either side. Ask about stipends, fellowships and recent thesis outcomes instead of looking for an MBA-style package.

faqs.question: Which exams are required for these Ph.D programmes?
faqs.answer: This page has no exam mapped for either college. Follow the official doctoral notification for the university test, interview and eligibility rules.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Noida?
faqs.answer: JIIT is recorded in Noida. Noida International University is recorded in Greater Noida. Both are in Uttar Pradesh's NCR region, but the commute is not the same.
